'''R2-M5''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and stationed at the Alliance's [[Titan Base]] in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]].<ref name="OSG">{{FFG|story=Operation: Shell Game (adventure)|book=Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|text=''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beta}}</ref>
